environment.description: Deployed inside a minimal Alpine-based container with a pivot_root(2) into /srv/jail at process start via the entrypoint wrapper. The jail directory tree is constructed at container build time with only: /srv/jail/data/ (empty JSON fixtures), /srv/jail/tmp/ (noexec,nosuid tmpfs), and the statically-linked Go binary. No /etc, /proc, /sys, /dev (except /dev/null), no shared libraries, no credential files. The container runs with a read-only root filesystem overlay (docker --read-only), and the seccomp profile is based on the default Docker profile with additional restrictions removing openat2, ptrace, and mount syscalls. The container's network namespace has iptables OUTPUT rules dropping all traffic except TCP dst port 443 to the internal ALB (blocking IMDS and lateral movement). Process runs as UID 65534 (nobody) with no capabilities (--cap-drop=ALL).

config.no_sensitive_files: no /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, /proc, /sys, no env credential files, no .aws directory
config.network_egress: iptables -A OUTPUT -d 169.254.169.254 -j DROP; iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp ! --dport 443 -j DROP
config.env_vars: no AWS credentials in environment, uses IRSA with audience-restricted OIDC token only
